DROP TABLE IF EXISTS cohort_summary;

CREATE TABLE cohort_summary AS 
WITH cohort_data AS (
    SELECT 
        cohort,
        COUNT(*) as cohort_size
    FROM participants
    GROUP BY cohort
)
SELECT 
    cd.cohort,
    cd.cohort_size,
    MIN(p.contact_notes) as example_comment
FROM cohort_data cd
LEFT JOIN participants p ON cd.cohort = p.cohort
GROUP BY cd.cohort, cd.cohort_size;
